name: lnpl
description: Author `.lnpl` for the linkly LLM-native platform. LNPL's vocabulary is closed and absent from model training data, so a plausible-looking source compiles and then silently does nothing — an unknown verb derives no effect, and most declarations are never enforced. This plugin routes the model to the vocabulary generated from the compiler's own tables, checks at session start that the compiler is reachable at all, surfaces `lnpl compile` diagnostics the moment a file is written, offers an independent reviewer subagent so the session that wrote a file does not grade its own vocabulary, derives spec cases from declarations, consults the knowledge base before design decisions, and gates completion on evidence.
